---
description: Write what a table or a column feeds, as a DBML slice.
title: ichnos downstream
---

`ichnos downstream` writes what a table or a column feeds, as a DBML slice.
It starts at `--table`, or at a column of it through `--column`.
A report is never an upstream end, so the command takes no `--report`.

## Usage

```{python}
#| label: help
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("downstream", "--help")
```

## Example

```{python}
#| label: example
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos(
    "downstream",
    "queries",
    "--table",
    "SALES.ORDERS",
    "--column",
    "ORDER_ID",
    "--budget",
    "2500",
)
```
